name: Glass repo card
oneLiner: a code repository card (name, description, language dot, contributors) pops in tilted on glass, the star count races up and lands in a gold star burst, then a trending pill springs in under the light
say: when the speaker mentions an open source project or a repo blowing up ('it has 24k stars', 'it was trending all week'): the burst lands on the star number, the pill on 'trending'
